title: get_changes_since (Chat) puts all changed IDs in added[], never in updated[]
description: ChatStore::get_changes_since returns all changed IDs in added[] and always returns updated[] as empty. This means every time a chat's last_message_at changes, the client sees it as a newly-created chat rather than an updated one. RFC 8620 section 5.2 requires that updated IDs go in updated[] and only genuinely new objects go in created[]. The sister method get_changes_since_ordered correctly classifies items using created_at_counter vs since_counter, but get_changes_since (used by ChatChangesHandler when no maxChanges is set) always reports all deltas as created. This will cause clients to treat every incoming message as creating a new chat rather than updating an existing one.
